prior.case_context: Dated 2026-10-07 exact MoTc2RuH/HMoTc2Ru superconductivity queries identified no experimental exact-phase benchmark. The MC2023 predicted phase is acknowledged prior. Novelty is this bounded Mo-for-W ordered hydride construction in the reviewed catalogue, not a first composition claim.

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: The actual source target has no negative sampled-path value and positive Gamma optical compression. Fine stress reaches 0.459 GPa although forces vanish by symmetry, so cell response remains a concrete next test. Hydrogen desorption/decomposition, cation disorder, Tc/Ru phase competition and SOC can change the result; radioactivity is a practical limitation, not fabricated evidence of phonon instability. No exact thermodynamic equilibrium or experimental realization is claimed.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0 eV/A, P=0.009 GPa, full max stress=0.459 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Mo replaces W on the unique body-centered metal site with H, Ru and two Tc roles retained. Volume contracts 0.5125%, Mo-Ru versus W-Ru falls 0.0046193 A and H-Mo versus H-W falls 0.0057705 A. All ten lambda values rise 14.206–21.248%, with separate Eli mu=.1 11.976 to 15.603 K. The effect is a measured coupled site/network construction, not a nominal-valence or DOS carrier inference.
proposed_contribution.next_action: At the frozen Mo/W site roles compare common volume and electronic/q sampling, then test the dominant H-loss or cation-disorder competitor and residual-cell strain. Stable persistent coupling gain supports the screen; a nontranslation unstable branch, low-energy decomposition or lost paired gain opposes it.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
